what_happened: Style/layout 2 (built-in microwave above a wall oven, left-hinged door; same as failures s8, s11, s14). Stage 0: carrot grasped at 127, released into the bowl at 330 (0.007 m from the centre), stage 0 at 330. Stage 1: bowl grasped at 387, released inside at 709, stage 1 at 728 (398 steps). Stage 2: like s8/s14 the base stopped to the right of the microwave and viewed it obliquely, but the gripper reached the door's outer face near its free edge (812-840) and swung it shut 821-903 (175 steps). Stage 3: it went to the keypad and pressed START/ENTER at 1070 (167 steps), with the wrist camera seeing the keypad roughly upright. Success at 1070.
